d:
Rahul gandhi ke bayan ko lekar jharkhand men siyasi ghamasan tej ho gaya hai. bijepi ne rahul gandhi ke bayan par saval uthate hue kangres ko ghera hai. vahin kangres aur jharkhand mukti morcha (JMM) ne bijepi ke aaropon ka javab diya hai. is mudde par donon pakshon ke bich jubani jang tej ho gaee hai.
